senses.gloss: a piece (of meat), portion (cmp. נֵתַח, מָנָה). Ib. VII, 5 ח׳ של דג וכ׳ a portion of an unclean fish. Ib. 100ᵃ שאני ח׳ הואיל וכ׳ with an entire piece the case is different, because it is fit to be offered to guests; a. fr.—Pl. חֲתִיכוֹת. Ib. VII, 5.
units: <cite ref="Keritot 17b:58">Kerith. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>חתיכה משתי ח׳</he> a doubt as to one piece out of two (of which one was forbidden and one allowed, and it is unknown which he ate); a. fr.
